reviews.comment:
Generalmente voy a cargar combustible los domingos, después del mediodía, cuando no hay mucha gente esperando cargar. Los empleados se mueven en cámara lenta!!! No tienen ganas de trabajar o no se que les sucede!! Pasa que soy socio del ACA!!

(Translated by Google)
I usually go to the gas station on Sundays, after midday, when there aren't many people waiting. The employees move at a snail's pace! They don't seem to want to work, or I don't know what's wrong with them! It's just that I'm an ACA member!
